findings.body: The previous P2 remains unresolved: this validator still rejects a recorded total of zero. src/forge/review.py:301–305 accepts pytest's zero-item collection, and lines 311–332 accept a zero TAP plan and publish its progress. A legitimate {done: 0, total: 0} therefore rejects the entire Machine refresh and also prevents confirmed stops while that snapshot exists. Accept zero totals and render elapsed time without a progress bar, avoiding division by zero in label().
findings.title: Accept zero-test progress without rejecting the entire snapshot

findings.body: If the selected run finishes after the fresh lanes read but before the stop command executes, src/forge/machine.py:286–287 prints "There is nothing to stop." and returns zero. This line discards that outcome and tells the person "Run stopped." even though Forge stopped nothing. Preserve or distinguish the command's no-target response and show the ended/replaced message with its next action. The existing stale-target tests remove the entry before the lanes read, so they do not exercise this final race.
findings.title: Preserve the stop command's no-target outcome

stop.reason: Owner accepts: the spinner's place-in-line ships as a separate small fix next; the extra drawing-test coverage is dismissed per the one-test-per-rule direction.
